indicators.name: Main drinking water is piped/tap water
indicators.description: Share of households whose MAIN source of drinking water is piped (tap) water in the dwelling or yard (WAT1 codes 01-02).

indicators.name: Main water is public tap, tanker or vendor
indicators.description: Share of households whose main drinking-water source is a public/communal tap, water-carrier/tanker or paid water vendor (WAT1 codes 06-08) — a proxy for water-access burden.

indicators.name: Water reported safe to drink
indicators.description: Share of households reporting their main water source as safe to drink before treatment.

indicators.name: Households that treat drinking water
indicators.description: Share of households that treat drinking water (always or sometimes; e.g. boiling, chlorine, filtering).

indicators.name: Water supply interrupted in last 12 months
indicators.description: Share of piped-water households that experienced a water-supply interruption in the last 12 months.

indicators.name: Water source more than 1 km away
indicators.description: Among households whose main water source is OUTSIDE the dwelling/yard (WAT2 universe), the share where the source is more than 1 kilometre away.

indicators.name: Flush toilet connected to sewer/septic
indicators.description: Share of households using a flush toilet connected to a public sewerage system or septic tank.

indicators.name: No open defecation
indicators.description: Share of households not practising open defecation.

indicators.name: Toilet facility shared with other households
indicators.description: Share of households sharing their toilet facility with other households.

indicators.name: Handwashing with soap observed/reported
indicators.description: Share of households whose members wash hands with soap and water after using the toilet.

indicators.name: Connection to mains electricity
indicators.description: Share of households with a connection to the mains electricity supply.

indicators.name: Household pays for electricity
indicators.description: Share of households that pay for their electricity.

indicators.name: Daily load shedding in last period
indicators.description: Share of households experiencing daily electricity interruptions (load shedding).

indicators.name: Any load shedding in last period
indicators.description: Share of households experiencing any electricity interruptions (1-2 days or more per week).

indicators.name: Main cooking energy is electricity
indicators.description: Share of households whose main cooking fuel is electricity (mains or other source).

indicators.name: Cooking with paraffin/wood/coal/dung
indicators.description: Share of households cooking mainly with paraffin, wood, coal/charcoal or animal dung.

indicators.name: Weekly refuse collection service
indicators.description: Share of households whose refuse is removed by the local authority/private company at least weekly.

indicators.name: Rubbish dumped on land/open spaces
indicators.description: Share of households using a communal refuse dump or dumping rubbish anywhere.

indicators.name: Cellular telephone in household
indicators.description: Share of households with access to a working cellular telephone.

indicators.name: Household uses mobile internet
indicators.description: Share of households using mobile internet services.

indicators.name: Household has fixed internet connection
indicators.description: Share of households with a fixed internet connection (fibre, ADSL, etc.).

indicators.name: Household uses minibus taxis
indicators.description: Share of households whose members use minibus/sedan/bakkie taxis.

indicators.name: Household uses trains
indicators.description: Share of households whose members use trains.

indicators.name: Went hungry due to lack of food/money (12m)
indicators.description: Share of households that experienced hunger because there was not enough food/money in the last 12 months (FSD module).

indicators.name: Went whole day without eating (12m)
indicators.description: Share of households that went without eating for a whole day due to lack of money/resources in the last 12 months (severe food insecurity).

indicators.name: Skipped meals due to lack of food/money (12m)
indicators.description: Share of households that skipped meals because of a lack of money or resources in the last 12 months.

indicators.name: Ate less than needed (12m)
indicators.description: Share of households that ate less than they thought they should due to lack of money/resources in the last 12 months.

indicators.name: Ran out of food (12m)
indicators.description: Share of households that ran out of food because of a lack of money or other resources in the last 12 months.

indicators.name: Worried about running out of food (12m)
indicators.description: Share of households worried they would run out of food due to lack of money/resources in the last 12 months.

indicators.name: Children hungry sometimes/often/always (12m)
indicators.description: Share of households with children (17 and younger) where a child went hungry sometimes, often or always in the last 12 months.

indicators.name: Meal-skipping on 5+ days in last 30 days
indicators.description: Among households that skipped meals, the share where it happened on five or more days in the past 30 days.

indicators.name: Household involved in agricultural production
indicators.description: Share of households involved in producing food or agricultural products in the last 12 months.

indicators.name: Agriculture is main food source
indicators.description: Among farming households, the share growing food as the main source of food for the household.

indicators.name: Main income is salaries/wages
indicators.description: Share of households whose main income source is salaries/wages/commission.

indicators.name: Main income is social grants
indicators.description: Share of households whose main income source is grants (including old-age grant).

indicators.name: Household reports no income
indicators.description: Share of households reporting no income.

indicators.name: Monthly expenditure R5,000 or more
indicators.description: Share of households spending R5,000 or more per month (expenditure band code >= 9).

indicators.name: Income insufficient for expenses
indicators.description: Share of households whose income is lower or much lower than their expenses.

indicators.name: Median total monthly household income
indicators.description: Survey-weighted median total monthly household income (rand); sentinel value 9,999,999 excluded.
indicators.caveat: Derived variable covers households with reported total monthly income; median used because the distribution has extreme top-codes/sentinels.

indicators.name: Household owns its dwelling
indicators.description: Share of households that own the dwelling they occupy.

indicators.name: Household owns a motor vehicle
indicators.description: Share of households owning one or more motor vehicles in working condition.

indicators.name: Household owns a fridge
indicators.description: Share of households owning a refrigerator.

indicators.name: Household owns an air conditioner
indicators.description: Share of households owning an air conditioner (excluding fans).

indicators.name: Household has pay-TV subscription
indicators.description: Share of households with a pay-TV subscription (e.g. DStv/M-Net).

indicators.name: Household owns a washing machine
indicators.description: Share of households owning a washing machine.

indicators.name: Dwelling has security features
indicators.description: Share of households whose dwelling has security features (e.g. alarm, security gates, armed response).

indicators.name: Household has an electric geyser
indicators.description: Share of households with an electric geyser.

indicators.name: Household has a borehole
indicators.description: Share of households with their own borehole.

indicators.name: Household has solar panels
indicators.description: Share of households owning solar panels.

indicators.name: Household has a solar water heater
indicators.description: Share of households with a solar water heater/geyser.

indicators.name: Household self-assesses as poor/very poor
indicators.description: Share of households describing themselves as poor or very poor (HWL4 self-assessment).

indicators.name: Less happy with life than 10 years ago
indicators.description: Share of respondents less happy with life than ten years ago.

indicators.name: Mean household size
indicators.description: Weighted mean number of people per household.

indicators.name: Persons per room (crowding)
indicators.description: Weighted ratio of household members to total rooms in the dwelling (all rooms counted, not only bedrooms — a crowding proxy).

indicators.name: Households with children under 5
indicators.description: Share of households with at least one child aged 0-4.

indicators.name: Mean children under 5 per household
indicators.description: Weighted mean number of children aged 0-4 per household.

indicators.name: Households with member aged 60+
indicators.description: Share of households with at least one member aged 60 or older.

indicators.name: Households receiving social grants
indicators.description: Share of households with at least one member receiving a social grant.

indicators.name: Mean monthly grant income per household
indicators.description: Weighted mean total monthly social-grant income among grant-receiving households (rand).

indicators.name: Mean medical-aid members per household
indicators.description: Weighted mean number of household members with medical aid.

indicators.name: Formal dwelling (house/flat/complex)
indicators.description: Share of households living in a formal dwelling (house, flat, cluster, townhouse or semi-detached). Excludes traditional, informal and backyard structures.

indicators.name: Informal dwelling/shack
indicators.description: Share of households living in an informal dwelling/shack (in or out of a backyard).

indicators.name: Households that own their dwelling
indicators.description: Share of households owning their dwelling (bonded, financed or fully paid off).

indicators.name: Renting from private owner
indicators.description: Share of households renting from a private individual.

indicators.name: RDP/state-subsidised dwelling
indicators.description: Share of households living in an RDP or state-subsidised dwelling.

indicators.name: Received housing subsidy
indicators.description: Share of households that received government assistance to obtain their dwelling.

indicators.name: Dwelling walls/roof/floor in weak condition
indicators.description: Share of households where walls, roof or floor are in weak/very weak condition.

indicators.name: Female share of population
indicators.description: Share of persons who are female (person-weighted).

indicators.name: Mean age
indicators.description: Person-weighted mean age in completed years.

indicators.name: Share of population under 18
indicators.description: Person-weighted share of the population aged 0-17.

indicators.name: Share of population aged 60+
indicators.description: Person-weighted share of the population aged 60 and older.

indicators.name: Employment rate (economically active)
indicators.description: Share of the economically active population (employed + unemployed) who are employed, persons aged 15-64 activity basis per GHS labour module.
indicators.caveat: Economically active defined by GHS labour-module routing; verify universe before external publication.

indicators.name: Unemployment rate (economically active)
indicators.description: Share of the economically active population who are unemployed and looking for work.

indicators.name: Share economically active
indicators.description: Share of persons aged 15+ who are economically active (employed or unemployed).

indicators.name: Worked for wages in last week
indicators.description: Share of persons who worked for a wage, salary, commission or payment in kind in the last week.

indicators.name: Employed in informal sector
indicators.description: Share of employed persons working in the informal (unregistered) sector.

indicators.name: Looking for work (last 4 weeks)
indicators.description: Share of economically active persons who looked for work or tried to start a business in the last four weeks.

indicators.name: Mean monthly salary (reported)
indicators.description: Person-weighted mean reported total monthly salary/pay at main job (rand).
indicators.caveat: Only respondents who reported an amount; sentinel 888888888 (none/refused/DK) excluded.

indicators.name: Highest education Grade 12 or higher
indicators.description: Share of persons aged 20+ whose highest completed education is Grade 12/matric or higher (EDU1 codes 12-28).

indicators.name: No schooling completed
indicators.description: Share of persons aged 20+ with no schooling (EDU1 code 98 = NO SCHOOLING).

indicators.name: Post-secondary qualification (diploma/degree)
indicators.description: Share of persons aged 20+ with a post-secondary qualification (diploma with matric, higher diploma, degree or higher; EDU1 codes 22-27).

indicators.name: School-age children attending school
indicators.description: Share of children aged 5-17 currently attending an educational institution.

indicators.name: Currently attending any educational institution
indicators.description: Share of persons aged 5+ currently attending any educational institution (school, university, ABET, etc.).

indicators.name: Medical aid membership
indicators.description: Share of persons with medical aid/hospital plan membership.

indicators.name: Self-reported health fair/poor
indicators.description: Share of persons rating their general health as fair or poor.

indicators.name: Ever told they have a chronic condition
indicators.description: Share of persons ever told by a health worker they have asthma, diabetes, cancer, HIV/AIDS, hypertension, arthritis, stroke, TB or pneumonia/bronchitis.

indicators.name: Disability (any difficulty)
indicators.description: Share of persons with a disability (derived: some or more difficulty in at least one functioning domain).

indicators.name: Severe disability
indicators.description: Share of persons with a severe disability (a lot of difficulty or unable in at least one domain).

indicators.name: Receives old-age grant
indicators.description: Share of persons eligible/applicable receiving the old-age grant.

indicators.name: Receives child support grant
indicators.description: Share of eligible children receiving the child support grant.

indicators.name: Receives SRD grant
indicators.description: Share of eligible persons receiving the Social Relief of Distress grant.

indicators.name: Receives any social grant
indicators.description: Share of persons receiving any government social grant or social relief assistance.

indicators.name: Access to a cellphone
indicators.description: Person-weighted share with access to a cellular telephone.

indicators.name: Owns a smartphone
indicators.description: Person-weighted share who own a smartphone.
